BiblicalUsage: Maadai was an Israelite of the sons of Bani, named among those who had taken foreign wives and put them away at Ezra's command. His name stands in the list of those who repented and set their households right.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maadai's single mention matters, because repentance is recorded by name, and God remembers those who turn back to Him.
